heabsy/qwen3.8-27b-uncensored-fast.name: Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored Fast by Heabsy
heabsy/qwen3.8-27b-uncensored-fast.description: Heabsy's NVFP4 build of Qwen3.8-27B by Alibaba Cloud, with refusal removal based on huihui-ai's Huihui-Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated. Quantized and calibrated by Heabsy, with unpublished weights under the Heabsy Model License. Supports text and image input, tools, and optional reasoning capped at 16,384 tokens within the output budget. This named build is separate from Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored.

hyperresearch/ousia-1.name: Ousia 1
hyperresearch/ousia-1.description: Ousia 1 is a web research model from Hyperresearch: it searches the web for your question and answers with numbered citations and a list of its sources. Answers usually take 30 to 70 seconds and arrive all at once, and harder questions can take several minutes. It follows the answer language and length set in a system message, but not formatting instructions. Leave the output limit unset or at least 15,000 tokens: a smaller limit cuts the research short. Text only, with no tool calling. Ousia 1 searches the web for you: searches based on your question are sent to search providers, some of which may use them to improve their services. Not zero-retention.

ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b.name: Granite 4.2 8B
ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b.description: IBM Granite 4.2 8B is an Apache 2.0-licensed dense model with native step-by-step reasoning and specialized training for agentic work. It can plan before acting, sequence tools, navigate codebases, work in terminals, and verify results across coding, search, mathematics, science, and complex instruction-following tasks.

inception/mercury-2.5-preview.name: Mercury 2.5 Preview
inception/mercury-2.5-preview.description: Mercury 2.5 Preview is Inception's latest and most intelligent diffusion language model. Instead of generating tokens strictly one at a time, it produces and refines multiple tokens in parallel, reaching up to 1,107 tokens per second on standard GPUs. It delivers a 10+ point intelligence gain over Mercury 2, with tunable reasoning, parallel tool calls, schema-aligned JSON output, and a 260K context window. It is built for latency-sensitive production work such as search agents, voice pipelines, customer support, rapid coding iteration, and coding subagents.

liquid/lfm-2.5-2.6b.name: LFM2.5 2.6B
liquid/lfm-2.5-2.6b.description: Liquid AI's compact 2.6B reasoning model for agent workflows, data extraction, RAG, and long-context processing. It supports tool calling and structured output, but Liquid advises against using it for agentic coding. Warning: prompts and responses may be logged and used for model training or service improvement; do not send sensitive data.

liquid/lfm-2.5-24b-a2b.name: LFM2.5 24B A2B
liquid/lfm-2.5-24b-a2b.description: Liquid AI's text-only mixture-of-experts model for reasoning and tool-using agents, with 24B total and 2.45B active parameters. It always thinks before answering and supports structured output. Pair it with retrieval for knowledge-heavy tasks. Open weights use the LFM Open License v1.0, with a $10M annual-revenue commercial threshold; hosted API use is subject to separate service terms that permit retention and use of prompts and responses for model training.

liquid/lfm-3-1.7b.name: LFM3 1.7B
liquid/lfm-3-1.7b.description: Liquid AI's compact 1.7B-parameter text model for tool use, structured output, data extraction, and specialized agents. It reasons before answering and supports a 262,144-token context window with up to 8,192 output tokens. Pair it with retrieval for knowledge-heavy tasks; it is not recommended for complex multi-step reasoning or agentic coding.
